title: CI/CD Triggers
subtitle: Fire a pipeline from WorkPilot and follow the runs it started

trigger.heading: Run a pipeline
trigger.selectProviderFirst: Pick a provider before triggering a run.

empty.title: No pipeline runs yet
empty.body: Runs triggered from here — or automatically on a PR or a merge — show up in this list with the status the provider reports.
empty.noProject: Open a project to configure its CI/CD triggers.

monitor.heading: Watch after a deployment
monitor.description: After a pipeline starts from WorkPilot, the health check and the metrics of the chosen source are compared with what they were before it, for a window of observation.
monitor.monitor_deploy_wait_minutes: Wait for the deployment to land (minutes)
monitor.auto_rollback: Roll back by itself on a critical verdict
monitor.autoRollbackHint: Off: the rollback is offered here. On: GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines go back to the last run that succeeded, unless the change holds a database migration.
monitor.fileHint: Metrics and thresholds: .workpilot/deploy-monitors.yaml (query in the source's language, kind error_rate, latency, throughput or custom, warning and critical in percent; canary_query compares the canary with the stable fleet at each sample). revert_pr: true opens a PR that reverts the deployed commit after a critical verdict; explain_incident: false keeps the model out of the incident report.

queryHint.prometheus: Each metric's query is PromQL; a vector is summed.
queryHint.datadog: Each metric's query is a Datadog metric query; the newest point of each series over the last five minutes is summed.
queryHint.newrelic: Each metric's query is NRQL with its SINCE clause; the numbers of the result are summed.
queryHint.cloudwatch: Each metric's query is a Metrics Insights query or metric math; the newest value of each result over the last five minutes is summed.
queryHint.grafana: Each metric's query is the data source's expression (PromQL for Prometheus or Mimir, LogQL for Loki); the newest value of each frame over the last five minutes is summed.

watch.notConfigured: Not watched: no health check or metric is configured.
watch.migrations: Database migrations between the good version and this one: {{files}}. A rollback restores the code only; handle these migrations by hand.

rollback.started: Rollback started: the last good run is running again.
rollback.blocked_migrations: Automatic rollback blocked by a database migration.

plan.manual: This provider cannot re-run a past pipeline on its commit: start the last good one again from its page.
plan.no_previous_success: No earlier successful run to go back to.
plan.not_configured: The provider settings are incomplete for a rollback.
plan.unreachable: The provider could not be reached to plan the rollback.
plan.unsupported: Rollback is not supported for this provider.
plan.offline: Strict offline mode: no provider is called, roll back by hand.

watch.revertHint: The branch still holds the faulty commit: revert it before the next deployment.
watch.confirm: Run the last good deployment again?

revertPr.exists: A revert PR is already open.
revertPr.failed: The revert PR could not be opened.
revertPr.conflict: The deployed commit does not revert cleanly: revert it by hand.
revertPr.no_commit: The provider did not say which commit it deployed: no revert PR.
revertPr.unknown_commit: The deployed commit is not in the local clone: fetch it, then revert it by hand.
revertPr.not_on_branch: The deployed commit is not on the target branch: nothing to revert there.
revertPr.offline: Strict offline mode: no revert PR is opened.
revertPr.unavailable: No forge is available to open the revert PR.

watch.linkedByHand: Roll back the linked services by hand too: {{projects}}.
watch.confirmLinked: Run the last good deployment again? These go back with it: {{projects}}.

linked.blocked_migrations: {{project}}: rollback blocked by a database migration.
linked.not_deployed_since: {{project}}: not deployed since the good version, nothing to roll back.
linked.missing: {{project}}: the project is no longer in the app.

alerts.heading: Alerts after a bad deployment
alerts.description: A degraded verdict goes to Slack and e-mail; a critical one also pages the on-call person through PagerDuty. Only the facts of the watch are sent, never the model's text.
alerts.offlineHint: Strict offline mode: only a webhook or an SMTP server on this machine or a private address is used; PagerDuty is not called.

links.heading: Services rolled back with this one
links.description: When a rollback of this project starts, the projects switched on here go back too, each with its own CI/CD settings, to where they were at this project's last good run. A project not deployed since then is left as it is.
links.none: No other project in the app.

figures.heading: Watch figures
figures.slow: The median is above the three-minute goal: shorten the wait or the interval in .workpilot/deploy-monitors.yaml, or turn the automatic rollback on.
figures.local: Computed on this machine from this project's watches; nothing is sent anywhere.
